verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developers.featurebase.app (HTTP 200) that links to markdown versions of doc pages. Many guide and API pages are served as agent-friendly index.md files, and the docs explicitly design endpoints for AI agents, such as the find/replace article-edit endpoint. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or first-party documentation explaining agent consumption of the docs, and no independent community corroboration of agents using it.
